title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Quick Reference: Application Channels, Renewal Window, Award Frequency and Reapplication Wait
content:
This quick reference lists, for each tier of the Patient Financial Assistance Program, the ways an application can be submitted, how many calendar days before an award's end date a renewal application is accepted, how many approved cases a patient may receive with decision dates within any 365 days, and how many calendar days must pass after an income-based denial before a new application is accepted (unless household income or size has changed).

| Tier | Ways an application can be submitted | Renewal window, calendar days before the award end date | Approved cases allowed with decision dates within any 365 days | Wait after an income-based denial, calendar days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | Online patient portal; mail; phone-assisted | 30 | 2 | 90 |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | Online patient portal; mail; phone-assisted | 30 | 2 | 90 |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | Online patient portal; mail; phone-assisted | 30 | 2 | 90 |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | Online patient portal; mail; phone-assisted | 30 | 2 | 90 |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | Online patient portal; mail; phone-assisted | 30 | 2 | 0 |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | Online patient portal; mail | 30 | 1 | 90 |

## Differences between tiers at a glance

- The Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment lists no phone-assisted channel; its channels are the online patient portal and mail.
- The Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment allows 1 approved case with decision dates within any 365 days; every other tier allows 2.
- The Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount carries a wait of 0 days after an income-based denial; every other tier carries 90 days.
- The renewal window is 30 calendar days for every tier.
